message: No detected input validation: The code only checks file existence and extension type before loading; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded only from the local filesystem with no remote fetching, so no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks are present or needed.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation steps only drop high-NaN columns/rows and normalize data; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models; it builds models from scratch, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is implemented or needed, but the control is absent.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs NaN dropping and column removal but never checks class balance, expected label sets, or detects anomalous label distributions before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense implemented anywhere in the pipeline code shown.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being used to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The pipeline loads data and processes it through drop_cols/drop_rows/normalize without any schema validation, shape checks, or range enforcement on incoming inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output probabilities, detects NaNs in predictions, or enforces calibrated thresholds before returning results.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses tabular regression/classification models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
